scope: Finite Gaussian transcription checks for physical smoothing contraction, the fixed reference-form norm bound, uniform weak derivative and Lipschitz bounds, and the scalar integrated Schrodinger equation. Lean independently constructs a common subsequence at all real times, proves weak form and physical convergence, and passes the scalar equation through this sequence by dominated convergence. The limit has the initial datum, is weakly continuous, and has norm at most its initial norm. Norm conservation, uniqueness, strong convergence and a unitary unbounded propagator are not established here. Full six-mode infinite dynamics, regulator removal, physical identification and the TOE remain open.
